questions.title: When would you like to host the dinner party?

questions.description: Any specific themes or decorations you'd like to incorporate?

questions.title: Would you like to hire a DJ or musician?
questions.description: If so, what type of music are you interested in?

questions.title: What are your budget and any dietary restrictions for the guests?
questions.description: Please let me know the budget and any dietary restrictions to accommodate.

candidate.taskDescription: Organize a dinner party for 8 friends.

verdict.notes: Set B's fatal flaw is Q7, which bundles budget and dietary restrictions into one compound question — a clear atomicity violation. It also wastes a question on hiring a DJ/musician (low priority for a home dinner party) while missing key unknowns like whether the host is cooking vs. catering and whether guests have been invited, which Set A covers more usefully.

verdict.notes: Set B misses two of the most critical planning unknowns — location and in-person vs. online preference — without which it's nearly impossible to find a real therapist. Questions like "Have you seen a therapist before?" and "How many sessions per week?" are low-value at the discovery stage and crowd out more actionable information; Q6 and Q7 also overlap significantly (both fish for concerns/preferences about the therapist).

Questions 1 and 2 also overlap significantly (both probe PM-related background/skills), reducing effective coverage further.

input: Untangle my German tax returns for 2020-2024

questions.title: Which tax software or services do you currently use for tax preparation?
questions.description: Provide specifics like program names and versions.

questions.title: How much time do you typically spend each year preparing your German taxes?
questions.description: Briefly describe your current workflow.

questions.title: What are the most challenging aspects of your current tax preparation process?
questions.description: List specific problems or time-consuming tasks.

questions.title: Have you considered hiring a professional tax preparer or accountant for recent years?
questions.description: Describe any prior experiences or reasons for reluctance.

questions.title: What financial documents do you need access to, such as W-2s, 1099s, and bank statements?
questions.description: List key documents you rely on.

questions.title: What is your preferred location for tax filing, online, in-person, or a combination?
questions.description: Explain your preferences.

questions.title: Are there any specific deadlines or deadlines for submitting 2020-2024 tax returns?
questions.description: Describe any important deadlines.

candidate.taskDescription: Streamline and simplify the process of filing and organizing German tax returns for the past four years.

verdict.notes: Set B is critically undermined by generic, non-German framing — mentioning W-2s and 1099s (US tax forms) instead of German equivalents like Lohnsteuerbescheinigung, and asking about "preferred location for filing" which is irrelevant to Germany's mandatory online Elster system. It misses essential unknowns like residency status, employment type, and Finanzamt, which are all critical to planning German tax returns specifically.
